steps.js: (async()=>{const rolagem=(el)=>{let c=el&&el.parentElement;while(c&&c!==document.body){const s=getComputedStyle(c);if(/(auto|scroll)/.test(s.overflowY)&&c.scrollHeight>c.clientHeight+4)return c;c=c.parentElement;}return null};const el=[...document.querySelectorAll('main div.relative.group')].filter(e=>e.offsetParent&&e.querySelector(':scope > button.cursor-grab')&&e.innerText.includes("Compras vs Vendas"))[0];if(!el)return 'SEM ALVO';const c=rolagem(el);if(!c)return 'SEM ROLAGEM';let dy=Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top-120);const y0=c.scrollTop;dy=Math.max(-y0,Math.min(c.scrollHeight-c.clientHeight-y0,dy));if(Math.abs(dy)<3)return 'ok';await new Promise(res=>{const t0=performance.now();const f=t=>{const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/900),e=p<.5?2*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,2)/2;c.scrollTop=y0+dy*e;p<1?requestAnimationFrame(f):res()};requestAnimationFrame(f)});return Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top)})()
